title: Expression Trees and Ambiguity
description: Hand-built trees demonstrate how grammar shape determines precedence and associativity, producing different answers from the same string.

steps.description: Reveal OPS: dictionary mapping operator symbols to lambda functions.
Reveal evaluate and show: recursive functions that compute and display tree structures.
Reveal precedence section: two different trees for 2 + 3 * 4.

steps.question: What does the layered grammar tree for 2 + 3 * 4 evaluate to?

steps.description: Reveal associativity section: left versus right grouping for 5 - 2 - 1.
Reveal exponentiation section: right-associative versus left-associative for 2 ^ 3 ^ 2.
Run to show precedence results 14 and 20.
Run to show associativity results 2 and 4.
Run to show exponentiation results 512 and 64.
